zh.title: 澳洲航空客機在雪梨重飛，澳洲運輸安全局調查兩機間隔事件
zh.summary: 澳洲航空一架波音 737 於 11 月 25 日進場時，機組員通報看見紐西蘭航空一架 A321 橫越跑道，決定重飛。澳洲運輸安全局已立案調查。
body: 澳洲運輸安全局（ATSB）11 月 26 日表示，澳洲航空班機在雪梨機場（SYD）進場時，航管已告知機組員，有飛機正在橫越跑道，落地許可會較晚發出。據通報，機組員尚未取得落地許可，目視紐西蘭航空客機後決定重飛。
調查人員將訪談雙方機組員與航管員，並檢視相關錄音及影像，釐清兩組機員當時收到哪些資訊、如何理解當下的狀況。ATSB 指出，重飛決定是當時發揮作用的一道安全防線；事件原因尚待調查，預計約八週後公布初步報告。

en.title: ATSB investigates after Qantas 737 goes around at Sydney as Air New Zealand jet crosses runway
en.summary: A Qantas 737 crew reported seeing an Air New Zealand A321 crossing the runway during its approach to Sydney on 25 November and decided to go around. The Australian Transport Safety Bureau has opened an investigation.
body: The ATSB said on 26 November that air traffic control had advised the Qantas crew approaching Sydney Airport (SYD) to expect a late landing clearance because aircraft were crossing the runway. The crew had not yet been cleared to land when it reported seeing the Air New Zealand jet and opted to go around.

Investigators will interview the flight crews and controllers and review recordings to establish what information each crew received and how they understood the situation. The ATSB identified the go-around as a safety defence that worked. It has not determined the cause and expects to issue a preliminary report in about eight weeks.

facts.claim: On 25 November at Sydney Airport, a Qantas 737 crew reported seeing an Air New Zealand A321 crossing the runway before the 737 had been cleared to land and elected to go around.
The ATSB opened investigation AO-2026-105. Its investigation record identifies the Qantas aircraft as VH-VZP.
The ATSB will interview flight crews and controllers and review recordings to establish what information each crew received. It expects a preliminary report in about eight weeks.
